cleanup_and_runtime_obligations: Close/join real query/binary owners, revoke stale handles and stop receivers before release.
Release ConfigFile/handle/service profile aliases before actual lock reacquisition, including closed wrappers kept alive.
Preserve durable committed/uncertain rows on late cancellation, admission failure and profile close; no cleanup that erases recovery truth.
Record actual private-profile cleanup, sanitizer and UI evidence only after cohort results.

intentional_Original_corrections.Native: Literal actual-query insertion with safe escaping; visible ASCII supported query validated before DNS.
intentional_Original_corrections.Original_measured: ^%s$ and word compile as ^QwordE$; dollars/backslash can throw.

intentional_Original_corrections.Native: Any failed post-filter rejects the whole row.
intentional_Original_corrections.Original_measured: A later valid field can resurrect a result rejected by an earlier filter.

intentional_Original_corrections.Native: Captured/interpolated text is inserted literally; no replacement-string authority.
intentional_Original_corrections.Original_measured: Unquoted replaceFirst interprets replacement syntax; $1 can leave ${a} unchanged.

magnet_domain.authority: Only real service-completed key can mint private move-only handle retaining actual parsed row, source snapshot, query lifetime and fresh receiver. No UI URI/hash/SID grant.
magnet_domain.cancellation: Final boundary owns durable completion; late stop cannot relabel committed truth. Old source action cohort withdrawn after config save.
magnet_domain.consumption: Actual source/current/query/receiver/worker/session/SAMEOFD, live policy equality, duplicates and pending recovery checked immediately before synchronous save under source gate.
magnet_domain.identity: Existing parser validates v1/full-v2/hybrid and supported hints; mapped v1 must agree; incomplete/zero/unsupported identities refuse.
limits: Normal direct Public only; I2P/Mixed and automatic/force starts not claimed.
Full-v2/hybrid URI parsing is not Original full32 manager restore qualification.
Owned metadata-engine admission is not remote metadata completion or payload transfer acceptance.

outcomes.Committed: Actual saved row read back; metadata admission is separate and may fail without deleting intent.
outcomes.Uncertain: Save boundary entered without proven outcome; explicit recovery/review, no admission and no blind retry.

magnet_domain.persistence: Existing MagnetPlugin.active.magnets/other_metadata Original format with stopped=true; unknown config/map bytes preserved. No invented subscription association/history.
magnet_domain.review: Explicit existing destination and direct Public route; fixed Resolve Metadata and Add Stopped.

Original.scope: Genuine saved-map Regex/JSON offline parsing and public FieldMapping/Matcher values; explicit hashes avoid manager-sensitive inference; no Core/manager/UI/network runtime.

Qt.scope: Installed Qt6.12 fixed limit compilation, ordinary valid no-match, anchored/unanchored catastrophic invalid-match and normal/fallback captures; no throughput benchmark.

not_claimed: Unrestricted external network or remote metadata/payload success
stop: Finish and publish only the current authorised chapter, then stop. No next implementation started.

template_domain.configured_bytes: Read-only actual saved-engine catalog; unknown and raw definition bytes retained. Configured root/base remains distinct from final response URL.
explicit_limits: ASCII common Java/PCRE syntax only: no backreferences/lookaround/inline flags/verbs/atomic or possessive forms/Unicode properties/class intersections.
Zero-width main/replacement patterns refuse; actual Java empty find can split a UTF16 surrogate.
NEL and Unicode line/paragraph separators refuse in advanced pattern subjects; LF/CRLF/ordinary Unicode captures covered.
Post-filter field content uses ASCII fold only. Query %s is visible ASCII, outside escaped/character-class contexts.
Case transformations refuse non-ASCII and locale-sensitive i-upcase/I-downcase. Invalid percent/UTF8 URL decode refuses.
Numeric date/age/rank and broader result mappings not claimed; publication text remains raw.
Engine l1/l2 category/content remappers, unsupported transformations, login/cookies/custom headers/proxy/context/provider modes refuse.

matcher.compiled_cache: At most256 exact pattern+flags entries per document, no global/source cache.
matcher.failure: Invalid match or work exhaustion is Limit, never empty success.

recipes: replace, ASCII ucase/lcase, UTF8 form urldecode
template_domain.regex_order: Normal first; DOTALL|MULTILINE fallback only if no rows survive.
